tests.title: A finished run refreshes the board in place — no reload, the panel stays (dispatch R7)
Home, the detail, then a finished run refreshes it in place — composed
R1 — a conflict card is one fact stated two incompatible ways
R2 — both positions are shown in full, each naming where it came from
R3 — the tool never picks: resolving is refused until you choose a side
R4 — resolving records which side lost, stays on Open, and offers the rewrite
R5 — a decision survives a rescan that reorders and swaps the sides
R5 — undo puts a settled conflict back, and the scanner is never asked to pick
R1/R2 — the panel opens on the click and streams the job while it runs
R4 — a person's second run takes over the running one: accepted, not refused
R4 — a run may nest inside the run driving it, and nesting is bounded
running one screen leaves every other screen's E2E result standing
R6/R8 — a run saves its whole log, and records every test case on its own
R8 — a run that matched no test is recorded as an error, never 0 of 0 passing
R8 — running ONE case leaves every other case's steps and log standing
R8 — a case keeps a LOG HISTORY, folded across runs
R8 — EVERY case that has run can expand its steps, not only the one you clicked
R7 — the run panel offers no background run
R7 — the panel and its log stay on screen after the run ends
R5 — cancel stops the job, and cancelling nothing is refused not crashed
Run from the board cell, watch it stream, the verdict lands — then read the detail in its three views — composed
R1 — the form persists what cannot be guessed, and reads it back
R1 — the setup cards are single-column blocks, not the home two-column grid
R1 — start mode saves backend and frontend, in order
R3 — a drafted PRD is canon the moment it is written: one CARD, no guess chip, nothing waiting, no gate
R4 — nothing found is the greenfield case: no rows, a prompt to write the first PRD
R2 — a crawled route is a row with its screenshot and NO PRD: inventory, never fake coverage
R6 — voice-over is a saved, per-project switch, off by default
R6 — the switch is disabled until piper is ready, with a copyable install helper
R5 — rerunning marks new routes new and leaves a settled row alone
A crawled row becomes a card — the rerun marks it, the draft lands as one card, home counts it and search finds it — composed
unproven — a requirement with no passing test reads unproven
proven — a current passing proof makes a requirement proven
a proof that predates the source no longer proves — editing the PRD IS the change
a stale-only pass does not read Passed either — status honours the same staleness filter as state
state is only ever proven or unproven — there is no reworded / accept state
a leftover guess: frontmatter line is inert — the screen reads exactly like any other
changed — a current pass whose text-pin no longer matches reads Changed
changed — a matching pin stays plainly Passed
changed is a modifier on Passed only — a failing test keeps the requirement Failed
renders — the detail carries NO gate and no accept button
renders — a leftover guess: frontmatter line renders exactly like a normal screen
renders — a beats block leads the requirement, the List reads it, and the proof rides its rows
renders — Focus fits the viewport: the schematic on first sight, the beats scrolling inside the card
renders — the drawn schematic fills the Focus slot: loop, stills per beat, grey when the text moves
renders — a Changed requirement wears the indigo changed chip, never a plain Passed
renders — the home banner counts a Changed requirement as drift
renders — the home strip counts what needs a look and deep-links the first one
